adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController#add_members, the code does `usernames.split(",").each` and only adds users when `User.find_by_username(username)` succeeds; otherwise it silently does nothing (no `strip`, no blank rejection, no error/partial failure reporting). It still returns `success_json` as long as `group.save` succeeds, even if zero members were actually added. This behavior is verifiable in the diff, but it may be an intentional UX/API choice (similar silent skipping existed in the prior incremental update code), so it’s not clearly a defect.
